title: Quick Search
description: Adds a quick search feature to minecraft
body:
<details>
<summary>Preview</summary>

![Search Bar of Spotlight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1af9407983ae17e275cf8add92926a850742cbb5.jpeg)

</details>



A Minecraft Mod that adds a quick search feature to minecraft. Allows the user to search for any block in the game. Also has commands for helping in buildings, like get player heads by name, save and load hotbar and inventory, etc.

## Keybinds
- `Y`: Open Item Search
- `U`: Open Commands

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
 Compatible with Modded Items and Blocks
</details>
